Unofficial build of `@devolutions/iron-remote-desktop-rdp` from unmodified upstream
[Devolutions/IronRDP@76c9785](https://github.com/Devolutions/IronRDP/commit/76c97856350dd1a7a826915164a33f3ea62b9f1f),
for use until an npm release includes the EGFX graphics pipeline.

- No fork patches: `UPSTREAM.patch` contains only the release workflow and these notes, and the
  workflow refuses to build if anything else differs from the upstream commit.
- Replaces `v0.7.0-egfx.1` to `v0.7.0-egfx.5`. Their EGFX, Progressive and decoder hardening
  changes are in upstream now (#1333, #1443, #1499, #1673, #1696, #1698, #1703, #1962, #2085,
  #2117, #2132, #2133, #2134, #2176, #2394).
- Upstream announces 16 bpp unless told otherwise, and xrdp refuses EGFX below 32 bpp. Pass
  `colorDepth(32)` to keep the graphics pipeline.
- Not included: a retained-memory bound for the Progressive decoder (proposed upstream separately).

Verify: `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and
`gh attestation verify devolutions-iron-remote-desktop-rdp-0.7.0.tgz -R huangzheng2016/IronRDP`.
